context: A skincare-product fan and a friend discuss ingredients at the store
purpose: Teach: 美容/成分/用品/焦点/脇/思わず/現れる/湖

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 見て見て、この新しい美容液、ずっと気になってたの。
lines.en: Look, look, this new beauty serum—I've been curious about it forever.
lines.style: Soft excited tone, leaning in close with sparkling eyes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: へえ、すごい棚の数だね。日用品コーナーの脇にこんな専門売り場あったんだ。
lines.en: Wow, what a huge shelf. I didn't know there was a specialty section next to the daily-goods aisle.
lines.style: Casual friendly tone, glancing around with mild surprise.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私はね、成分表示をちゃんとチェックするのに焦点を置いてるの。
lines.en: You know, I really make a point of checking the ingredient labels carefully.
lines.style: Earnest and a little proud, holding up a bottle to read.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: えらいなあ。私なんてパッケージ可愛いと思わず手が伸びちゃう。
lines.en: Impressive. Me, I just unconsciously reach for whatever has cute packaging.
lines.style: Self-deprecating laugh, shrugging with playful honesty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ふふ、でも肌に合わないと赤みが出たり、ブツブツが現れることもあるから気をつけてね。
lines.en: Hehe, but be careful—if it doesn't suit your skin, redness or little bumps can appear.
lines.style: Gentle warning tone, motherly but warm and caring.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そっか…そういえば先週、湖の近くの旅館で乾燥がひどくてさ。
lines.en: Right... speaking of which, last week at the inn near the lake, my skin got terribly dry.
lines.style: Reflective sigh, recalling a recent trip with a wry smile.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: じゃあ保湿用品のコーナーで一緒に選ぼう?私のおすすめ教えてあげる。
lines.en: Then let's pick something together in the moisturizing-goods corner. I'll show you my recommendations.
lines.style: Bright and helpful, already pulling items off the shelf eagerly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 頼もしい!じゃあメイ先生、本日の美容講座よろしくお願いします。
lines.en: So reliable! Then, Professor Mei, please proceed with today's beauty lecture.
lines.style: Teasing playful bow, exaggerated mock-formal voice.
